suggestions: Provide specific Echo findings: LVEF (e.g., 32%), LV dimensions (e.g., LVIDD 6.2 cm), regional wall motion abnormalities (e.g., akinetic anterior wall), valvular function (e.g., moderate MR)

Provide specific ECG interpretation: Rate (e.g., AF with ventricular rate 88 bpm), axis (e.g., left axis deviation -35°), QRS duration (e.g., 128 ms suggesting LBBB), LVH criteria (Sokolow-Lyon 42 mm)
Document systematic Echo approach: M-mode measurements, 2D assessment (wall motion, chambers), Doppler (valves, diastolic function), EF calculation method
Document systematic ECG approach: Rate (method), Rhythm (P waves? AF?), Axis (I/aVF), Intervals (PR, QRS, QT), P waves, QRS morphology, ST/T changes
Provide patient-specific vital signs consistent with chronic HFrEF: e.g., BP 105/68 (low due to ACE-I/ARB), HR 72 (beta-blocker), bibasal crackles on auscultation, elevated JVP
Include NYHA functional class assessment (e.g., NYHA Class III - symptomatic on minimal exertion)
Specify Australian management: GDMT medications (ACE-I/ARB/ARNI, beta-blocker, MRA, SGLT2-I as per NHFA guidelines), PBS restrictions, CRT/ICD criteria (LVEF <35%, QRS >120 ms)

agent_evaluations.detailed_rationale: This OSCE station is a template placeholder, not a functional assessment tool. CRITICAL FAILURES: (1) No systematic radiology interpretation - the expected answer 'The investigations show findings consistent with Chronic HFrEF' violates the mandatory ABCDE/7-step approach; a radiology expert must describe specific Echo findings (LVEF, chamber sizes, wall motion) and ECG findings (rhythm, axis, QRS morphology, LVH criteria), not generic diagnoses. (2) No actual clinical content - patient presentation, history, examination findings, and vital signs are copy-pasted templates identical across all 50 OSCEs; constraints/01-medical-accuracy.md requires 100% real clinical content generated via LLM. (3) Empty RAG citations - all 3 references have content:'' preventing verification of medical accuracy. (4) No Australian context - management section lacks NHFA/CSANZ HF guidelines, PBS medication restrictions, or CRT/ICD referral pathways. (5) Zero educational value - candidates cannot learn systematic Echo/ECG interpretation from 'findings consistent with diagnosis'. This violates the core purpose of AMC Clinical Examination preparation. RADIOLOGY EXPERT ASSESSMENT: A competent radiologist interpreting Echo/ECG for HFrEF would provide: Echo - 'Dilated LV (LVIDD 6.2 cm, normal <5.5 cm), severely impaired systolic function (LVEF 28% by Simpson's biplane), global hypokinesis with akinetic anterior/septal walls (prior LAD territory infarct), moderate functional MR (dilated annulus), dilated LA (volume 52 mL/m²), Grade II diastolic dysfunction'; ECG - 'AF with controlled ventricular response (rate 72 bpm), left axis deviation (-40°), LBBB pattern (QRS 142 ms, broad notched R in I/aVL/V5-V6, absent septal Q waves), voltage criteria for LVH (S V1 + R V5 = 44 mm), no acute ischaemia'. This OSCE requires complete regeneration with real clinical content, systematic interpretation frameworks, and Australian guidelines integration. Current version is NOT suitable for Ralph autonomous execution or candidate assessment.
